queue.best_vehicle: SENS itself — the purest on-list Direct vehicle (world-first 1-year implantable CGM); TRIB adequate R&D-stage on-list; TNDM/DXCM weak off-list benchmarks. SENS is a strong, not weak, proxy.
queue.path: N-archetype share-shift + re-rate. Mechanism: sole long-duration implantable-CGM pure-play recaptured its own commercial channel (revenue-share eliminated Jan-1-2026 → per-unit revenue + structural GM step-up) and takes share in a ~$15B/~15%-CAGR market ~98%-locked by Abbott/Dexcom/Medtronic. Rev $62M FY26 → HCW ~$118M 2027 → Freedom (2027-28) + twiist-AID attach; even ~1-2% of $15B = $150-300M rev. At ~5x sales that is ~$1B+ EV vs ~$348M cap → ~3-4x, plausibly >=4x with multiple expansion off an all-time-low base (market pricing dilution-not-success). DISCRIMINATORS: revenue ACTUALLY converting+accelerating (Q1 +87% YoY, raised guide, reorders above plan, DTC +100%) = SHOWS strongest signal; milestones HIT on date (EU CE, channel reversion, ADA Jun-6 RWE) = SHOWS; reimbursement (Medicare + Aetna/Cigna/UNH/BCBS) in place = anchor-equivalent SHOWS; GM inflection real but GAAP-positive bridge years out = PARTIAL. 3-of-4 show/partial, anchored on a printed structural revenue+margin inflection, not a round-tripper tell.
queue.asymmetry: Bull ~4-6x (share capture + re-rate as skepticism breaks + Freedom optionality); base ~1.5-2x (guided ramp + modest re-rate off depressed base); bear ~-50 to -70% (continued dilution / share-shift stalls, but reimbursed shipping product + reclaimed channel economics = partial floor, not zero). U/D clearly favorable — downside already heavily discounted at all-time lows despite accelerating fundamentals.
queue.survival: Passes — fragile but funded, NOT ruin. Pro-forma ~$156M cash + ~$85M undrawn Hercules; FY26 cash use $110-120M (~$28M/qtr, declining as revenue ramps); mgmt states financing in place to reach Freedom launch in 2028. Cash alone ~5.5 qtrs; debt facility + declining burn supports into-2028 → clears the §9 <6-quarter ruin bar. Priced offerings (not toxic convertibles), no going-concern flag. Pre-profit is not impairment (§7 trap). Permanent-impairment risk = chronic dilution-at-lows, but that caps per-share UPSIDE, it is not a death-spiral to zero.
queue.strongest_bear: SENS is a serial diluter at all-time lows — $80M offering priced at $5.00 in April upsized to $92M, shareholders just doubled the authorized share count, and FY26 cash burn ($110-120M) is ~2x annual revenue. Even if Eversense 365 executes, relentless issuance at depressed prices can cap per-share upside (revenue 3x → stock flat), and the long-duration wedge may stay a niche against a ~98%-locked incumbent field that iterates fast and trends cheaper/less-invasive. The multibagger needs share capture AND multiple expansion AND dilution discipline simultaneously — this threatens the per-share MAGNITUDE of the path, not its existence or survival.
